topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: I can’t believe it. Of course, it had to be both of us. Now we’re stuck with this old house, all because Grandma left it to us. Like we needed more responsibility. I mean, can you even imagine trying to split the maintenance and all the headaches? Not to mention the arguments over who gets to decide what to do with it. Like, I get it, it’s sentimental, but what about practical? What about what we actually want? This is just perfect. Just what we needed.
